summary: Tokio async sleep seam for the bounded transactional outbox poller runtime.
claim_boundary: Runtime timer seam only. This slice adds an async Tokio sleeper and an async bounded poller loop over injected worker-cycle and sleeper traits. It does not open a database pool, claim rows, publish to a broker, call gRPC, spawn a daemon, install a process supervisor, deploy workloads, or prove production delivery guarantees.

source_basis.used_for: Confirming that tokio::time::sleep is feature-gated by Tokio's time feature, returns a future awaited for elapsed duration, performs no work while awaiting, and must be used from a runtime/timer context. The implementation uses this only behind the runtime-specific app crate seam.

facets.F1_simplicity: The new crate owns only runtime-specific async sleep wiring and delegates poller policy to oya-shared-transactional-outbox-poller-app and worker-cycle behavior to injected traits.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The seam prepares future horizontally scaled publisher workers by making timer backoff behavior runtime-backed while preserving bounded ticks, idle shutdown, capped error backoff, and deterministic reports.
facets.F3_adversarial: Tests cover sleeping inside a Tokio runtime, no sleep after terminal idle shutdown, capped error backoff between non-terminal errors, aggregate work counts, and max-tick stop behavior.
facets.F4_api_contract: The public surface is explicit: AsyncOutboxPollerCycleRunner, AsyncOutboxPollerSleeper, TokioOutboxPollerSleeper, BoxPollerFuture, and run_tokio_bounded_outbox_poller.
facets.F5_quality: Focused runtime tests plus the 41-package backbone check/test/clippy/fmt matrix, cargo-deny, license-policy, cargo-prefix, catalog/data-class known-blocker probes, parse/config validation, dependency-seam, honest-claims, and diff hygiene are part of this run.
facets.F6_operations: The runtime returns OutboxPollerRunReport with stop reason, per-tick planned delays, work counts, and error counts; no daemon lifecycle or supervisor is introduced.
facets.F7_security_privacy: The runtime reports operational counts and error refs only; it carries no payload body, raw mail/message/post content, secrets, database URL, broker URL, or credential material.
facets.F8_supply_chain: Tokio was already a workspace dependency; this slice scopes its time feature use to the new app crate and updates dependency-rationales allowlisting instead of leaking Tokio into domain/kernel/usecase crates.
facets.F9_testing: Focused tests passed for the runtime crate and the broad backbone matrix passed 254 unit tests plus the existing ignored metrics adapter doctest.
facets.F10_ci_cd: GitHub Actions and all four Jenkins package matrices include the runtime crate, preserving Jenkins/GitHub Actions parity doctrine without claiming remote CI execution.
facets.F11_observability: Per-tick reports expose planned delay, idle/work/error outcome, consecutive idle/error streaks, and aggregate claimed/published/dead-letter/error counts for future telemetry binding.
facets.F13_reversibility: The slice is isolated to one runtime app crate, registry row, dependency rationale, CI matrix entries, and task/evidence documentation, so removal does not affect pure poller policy or worker-cycle crates.
